title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode4 Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Aaaaaaaargh! Wh-What on earth?!
Oh wait, it's just a costume?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right, so you're a Miku mascot. Oh boy, you gave me a scare.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Um... Excuse me, mascot. Can you tell me where I am?

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line: Welcome to your SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? “Your SEKAI”? I have no idea what that is.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do you mind taking off that costume and talking to me normally for a minute?

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line: No problem! Just a moment...

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line: I can't take it off...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Uh, yeah, it seems rather unwieldy.
Fine, I'll help you get the head off. Let's give it...a good pull...aaand...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Aah! That's better!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...,,
You've got to be joking... You're Hatsune Miku?!
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's right♪ I'm Miku☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No way... Haha, that's impossible. Miku's a whatcha-you-call-it, a VIRTUAL SINGER.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I get it. This is some kind of elaborate special effect!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What was that sound?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! We have to get ready for the show! Come on, we must hurry!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? Hey, don't push me! Where are you taking me?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Is that a circus tent? No, a stage?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: All the props are ready, and the stage lighting is all set. Today's show is going to be great as usual.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm sure it will! I can't wait for it to start, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting☆
Look who I brought with me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for going out to get him, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa! You came to the show too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is that...KAITO?! And you're here too?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How can you be so calm?
This isn't normal, it's okay to panic, you know!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Why? It's really fun being here, and I'm happy to meet KAITO and Miku!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Don't you have any common sense...
Sigh. No. Of course you don't.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Strange... I swear I've seen this stage somewhere before...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, it's nice to meet you.
As you already know, I'm KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I can see you're still a bit shaken by this unfamiliar place. We have a bit of time before the show begins. Allow me to explain about this world.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This SEKAI is a world created by my feelings?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that is correct.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now I remember Miku saying that too. I'm extraordinary in many ways, but it's hard to believe that I could create new worlds...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You made this entire amazing world, Tsukasa! Wow! I didn't know stars had POWERS!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ouch! That really hurt! But...that means this isn't a dream.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This SEKAI is connected to your world through a song. You must have played “Untitled” to come here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that you mention it... Emu pressed play on that song and the next moment I was here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's not that I can't wrap my head around it, but I do have some questions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: First of all, why are VIRTUAL SINGERS like you and Miku in this world?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Our role is to help the creators of the SEKAI to discover their true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Their true feelings?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. You see, songs are crystallizations of feelings.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: When you find out what your true feelings are, they take the form of a song, which we can then sing together with you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, so let's get this straight. What you want from me is to sing a song? I can do that anytime.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll sing the song, and then you let me go back to my own world, deal? I can't be wasting time in fictional universes when I'm trying to become a star.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You can't sing that particular song because it doesn't exist yet. You've forgotten your true feelings, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's simply not possible! I know what I feel and what I want. I have but one goal in my life: to become the world's top star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rain or shine, wind or snow, my one true wish doesn't change! Even that time I was bedridden, suffering from mumps, I kept thinking about it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't you think there are other things that matter to you too, besides stardom? For example, making people happy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Making people happy?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Think about it♪ Or better, why don't you do a show with us here? That should help you remember what it was that you truly wanted!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You want me to perform here? In this world?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We get to perform with you?! How wonderful!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Shows in SEKAI are always great fun.
They're full of surprises, too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Such as this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Why is this sorry-looking stuffed rabbit tied to balloons?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Hello, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa! It's got a speaker inside?
You got me there, for a moment I really thought it spoke.

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: I did speak!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It...replied?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line:
Don't you remember me?
Did you really forget?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What does it want from me?!
This is getting quite disturbing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: D-Don't come any closer! Aaargh!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh no! He fell and hit his head!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa! Tsukasaaa!
